other_conditions: Applicant/organization must be a resident of or established in Chhattisgarh
Must have long‑term involvement in permanent charitable, patriotic and social service work within the state
Past work should be outstanding and continuously active at present
Contribution should have a wider impact and demonstrate innovation over traditional methods
Any applicant who is a member of that year’s award jury is ineligible
Any applicant who has received a similar charity award in the last five years is ineligible
Government or semi‑government institutions and their employees are not eligible
Work must be continuous, free from conflicts, and supported by proper evidence
Normally only one person or organization is selected, though two may be chosen with prize money divided equally
Not being selected in one year does not preclude future applications
benefits_summary: An award amount of ₹1,00,000 and a certificate of appreciation, plus a traveling allowance equivalent to a Grade‑A level officer for the awardee
